name: BASS
rationale: Solid-fuel burning and extinction research; the local corpus contains related BASS/BASS-II solid-fuel publications.

name: BASS-II
aliases: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
rationale: Follow-on solid-fuel research; local metadata associates SIBAL/PMMA literature with BASS and BASS-II.

name: SAFFIRE-I
rationale: Large-scale spacecraft-relevant flame spread and fire growth evidence.

name: SAFFIRE-II
rationale: Larger-scale material burning research; local papers discuss the Saffire series.

name: SAFFIRE-III
rationale: Large-scale microgravity flame-spread context; test-specific numerical details require the original PSI files.

name: SAME
rationale: Smoke/aerosol characterization that informs spacecraft fire detection.

name: SAME-R
rationale: NASA PSI record describes smoke-particle size and transport, detector response, and 66 flight test points.

name: DAFT
aliases: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test
rationale: Dust/aerosol detection hardware feasibility; related NASA context uses modified P-Trak hardware.

name: DAFT-2
aliases: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test 2
rationale: Dust/aerosol measurement context; details not sufficiently represented in the local paper corpus.

name: FLEX
rationale: NASA PSI record describes liquid-droplet flammability limits and gaseous suppressant investigations.

name: FLEX-2
rationale: Droplet-combustion follow-on context appears in supplied paper metadata; exact test matrix is not fully included.

name: CFI
rationale: Cool-flame research context; do not transfer findings to solid-fuel or droplet cases without evidence.

name: ACME
rationale: A group of gaseous-flame investigations using the Combustion Integrated Rack; sub-experiment objectives differ.

name: BRE
rationale: NASA describes BRE as an ACME experiment focused on spacecraft material flammability and extinction behavior.

name: E-FIELD Flames
rationale: Electric-field effects on flames; this is not a direct partial-gravity experiment.

name: CFI-G
rationale: Gaseous cool-flame research; retrieve source-specific tests before quoting oxygen ranges.

name: SPICE
rationale: NASA PSI describes non-buoyant jet diffusion flames and co-flow effects in microgravity and analogous ground tests.

name: SLICE
aliases: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiment
rationale: Combustion investigation listed by NASA; local source coverage is limited.
